machine.description: Automated Material Handling System (AMHS) cleanroom stocker for storing, buffering, and N2-purging 300mm Front Opening Unified Pods (FOUPs) between wafer prep and assembly bays.
machine.manufacturingProcess: Overhead Hoist Transport (OHT) vehicles deposit FOUP carriers at load ports. A high-speed dual-axis Cartesian robotic crane transfers cassettes into storage bays while ultra-pure N2 purge nozzles prevent surface oxidation and moisture adsorption.
subsystems: FOUP Smart Load Port & RFID Cassette Reader
Ceiling OHT Vehicle Rail Interface & Buffer Station
Laminar Airflow Fan Filter Unit (FFU) & Particle Ionizer

components.name: Robotic Crane Gripper
components.function: Transfers 300mm FOUPs between load ports and storage shelving.
components.importantParameters: Crane velocity (m/s), vibration (mm/s), gripper clamping force (N).
components.degradationIndicators: Crane track chatter (>0.3 mm/s), gripper timing delays.

components.name: N2 Purge Manifold
components.function: Delivers continuous 99.999% purity N2 gas into FOUP purge ports.
components.importantParameters: N2 purge pressure (kPa), mass flow rate (SLPM), moisture (ppb).
components.degradationIndicators: Purge pressure drop (<40 kPa), manifold solenoid valve leakage.

components.name: Load Port Docking Mechanism
components.function: Clamps FOUP and opens automated door under ISO 1 mini-environment.
components.importantParameters: Door seal vacuum level (kPa), latch actuation torque (Nm).
components.degradationIndicators: Door seal vacuum drop, latch alignment timeout.

sensors.name: Robotic Crane Vibration
sensors.purpose: Monitors crane linear guide rail vibration and bearing smoothness.

sensors.name: N2 Purge Pressure
sensors.purpose: Monitors nitrogen purge line pressure delivered to stored FOUPs.

sensors.name: Internal Enclosure Temp
sensors.purpose: Measures ambient temperature within sealed stocker bay.

warning.description: Rail particulate or guide wheel flat spot

critical.description: Imminent crane jam or motor bearing failure
Loss of N2 purge: Wafer oxidation risk

normal.description: Measures ambient temperature within sealed stocker bay.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: N2 purity > 99.999%, cleanroom class ISO 1 inside enclosure
operatingConditions.maximumContinuousOperation: 720 hours before crane track optical inspection

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Linear guide rail wipe and cleanroom perfluoropolyether grease lube
maintenance.procedureSummary: Clean stainless steel guide rail with lint-free wipes and apply vacuum-grade PFPE grease.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Filter cartridge replacement & seal integrity leak test
maintenance.procedureSummary: Isolate N2 supply, swap 0.003µm particulate filter, verify zero pressure drop across manifold.

degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Risk of FOUP cassette micro-shaking and wafer scuffing
Oxygen concentration in FOUP rises above 5 ppm

symptoms.recommendedAction: Clean optical encoder scale with isopropanol and adjust timing belt tension.

failureScenarios.symptom: Crane Guide Rail Roller Wear & Micro-Chatter
failureScenarios.recommendedAction: Replace crane guide roller assemblies and execute dynamic axis calibration.
verificationSteps: Run 10-cycle automated pickup repeatability test (< 0.1mm tolerance)
